name: Leen
source:
Third prince of the Kingdom of Regalia.  His mother, Dede, passed away when he was five years old. Because his mother was a slave turned concubine, he was never in contention for the throne.

At the age of 20, he was assigned as a count to the worst territory in the kingdom, Borondo. A territory notorious for suffering from famines.

On his way to Borondo, he encounters a female magician who has lost her donkey. He gives her his horse and in return she gives him a magic lamp.

In Regalia, princes and kings have magicians as a spiritual protector, tutor, and advisor, but Leen does not have one of his own.

Instead he has a trio assassins who serve as his guards. They also serve as his magicians, if you could call them that.

He is not good at swordsmanship, but he is quick on his feet. He is a proficient swimmer and a talented painter.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/103kyonyu5/#character]official site[/url]]
